Crush Control: Electron runtime third-party notice
Runtime covered: Electron 45.1.0 / Chromium 156.0.8078.49, Windows x64

Electron and Chromium contain software by many authors under separate licences.
The original application licence does not replace or restrict those licences.
Copyright attributions and the full original terms are preserved verbatim in
LICENSE.electron.txt and LICENSES.chromium.html alongside this notice. Additional
component licence files, copied verbatim from the pinned sources, are indexed by
runtime-source-manifest.json and included under LICENSES/ in this repository.

FFmpeg is distributed under LGPL 2.1 or later for the selected Windows build.
Copyright and individual authorship remain in its source files and in the FFmpeg
section of LICENSES.chromium.html. The checked Windows configuration disables
GPL, nonfree, and GPLv3 components. Its complete upstream source tree, the Opus
dependency, NASM source/build support, Chromium GN build scripts and Electron's
downstream patches were assembled locally in separate source materials. Those
source archives are not included in this repository or published.

Blink/WebKit includes files under GNU Library GPL version 2 or later and BSD
terms. Complete renderer, common and public source directories and Electron's
patch stack were assembled locally. Other source collected locally includes Mozilla/NSPR/ISimpleDOM, Hunspell and dictionaries, Eigen, axe-core,
gRPC, hyphenation patterns, libusb and the complete vendored Symphonia crates.
These are conservative source inclusions, not a claim that every such component
is linked into the Windows executable. All original file-specific terms remain.

JSZip explicitly offers MIT or GPLv3; this distribution selects MIT. HIDAPI's
BSD alternative is addressed in the main application third-party notices.
The presence of alternative GPL text in a combined notice does not change that
selection. Other exceptions and alternatives retain their exact upstream terms.

Source access and exact revisions: see SOURCE_ACCESS.md, SOURCE_INDEX.md and
runtime-source-manifest.json. SHA256SUMS.txt identifies the audited local source
files; their archives are absent from this repository. The manifest records a
historical local assembly, not source files present in a fresh clone.

Recipient rights: rights to copy, modify and redistribute covered components
remain governed by their licences. The application terms must permit the
modification and reverse engineering necessary to debug modifications to
LGPL-covered libraries to the extent those licences require. No proprietary
application term is intended to prohibit those activities.

Publication status: the application source and these notices are published
separately from the runtime source archives. Those archives were assembled and
checksummed locally but have not been published or delivered to prior beta
recipients. Beta.9 binary publication remains blocked.
The complete combined-runtime relink source/object closure has not been certified,
and no binary rebuild or modified-library test has been performed. This notice
is not a promise of completed source delivery, a written three-year source offer,
or a blanket compliance clearance. See SOURCE_ACCESS.md for the distinctions.
